skin-fade.name: Skin Fade
skin-fade.detail: The sides blend down to bare skin. The height of the fade and the length on top can be discussed with your barber.

low-taper.name: Low Taper
low-taper.detail: A gradual taper around the temples and nape keeps more length through the sides.

textured-crop.name: Textured Crop
textured-crop.detail: A short top with a textured finish and a forward fringe. The fringe length changes how the cut frames the face.

classic-cut.name: Classic Cut
classic-cut.detail: A balanced shape with a longer top and neatly tapered sides. The top can be worn with a natural part.
